verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable webhook endpoints or event subscriptions for Atlas itself; the docs cover incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filings, SAFEs and banking. Stripe's broader payments platform is a separate product and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
